label: casual-600-300
generator: exact native Rust release bots; workload-aware independent ten-client shards
scope: native ARM64 single-container 4-CPU/4-GiB loopback capacity; PostgreSQL, server and generators share the cgroup; not RU-host/uplink/WAN/production SLA

input.scope: successful signed UDP sends at producer; no per-command server ACK, send-gap or input-to-snapshot latency qualification

wire.scope: received wire including account traffic; ordered per-peer producer tick span, not independent send timestamps or latency; native driver drains all buffered snapshots

producer_timing.scope: soak-only cumulative histogram differences; wall time includes OS descheduling; quantiles are bucket bounds, not exact percentiles; overflow has no finite upper bound

server_load.scope: final cumulative verified signed application dispatch and ordinary gameplay Transform handler entry; snapshot age of the latest transform after complete kernel sends; actual world-broadcast intervals; not per-command ACK latency, coordinate-change proof, packet delivery, WAN or SLA
server_load.quantile_scope: mean and exclusive histogram upper bounds only; overflow has no finite upper bound; cumulative process lifetime, not soak-only subtraction
server_load.instrumentation_scope: opt-in per-second JSON stderr reports add measurement overhead; this is an instrumented loopback run
